profile.headline: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer at Amazon LEO
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer at Amazon LEO
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Quality Assurance Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive industry. Skilled in Databases, Test Management, Management, Test Planning, and Regression Testing. Strong engineering professional with a Embedded System Certification focused in Real Time System from The University of Washington Seattle.

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer at Amazon LEO
Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Assess and improve firmware automation coverage for satellite communication systems. Develop Python/Pytest-based validation frameworks for embedded platforms. Support automation initiatives involving Rust and C++ components. Drive improvements in CI/CD workflows, regression coverage, and release readiness.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Lead
positions.description: Led distributed QA team supporting Meta AI and Live Translation features for Smart Glasses. Coordinated onshore and offshore engineering resources. Drove automation initiatives that reduced manual testing effort. Partnered with engineering and product teams to ensure release readiness.

positions.title: Sr. SDET
positions.description:
* Bug fixes for the Biaggi Application (Hardware Test Sequences Automated Test Manager Application)
* Bug fixes and enhances the core framework that created for Microsoft Hardware Test Tool Group including enhanced the test logging performances and reduced the CPU usage
* Design, implement, and test the application / driver for Mercury Vapor
* Enhance the features for Manufacturer Test Equipment automated test applications that are used in Microsoft Hardware Test Tool Group
* Design, implement, and execute tests for KeyPS2 Test Application that is used to test new keyboards, include expanding the test coverage for the keyboard
* Technologies that involved in these automated test systems:
-	Visual Studio VB.NET / C# / C++
